part.text:
Fixed. The bug was in `packages/runtime-core/src/helpers/renderList.ts`: for any array with `__v_isReactive` set — including `shallowReactive` arrays — items were unconditionally wrapped with `reactive()`.

The fix restructures the array/string branch to match the upstream approach:
- Only wrap items (`toReactive`) when the source is a *deep* reactive array (`!isShallow(source)`), so `shallowReactive` items stay untouched (renderList.ts:69-84).
- Iterate via `shallowReadArray(source)` (raw array with tracking via the `Symbol.iterator` instrumentation) instead of the custom `__v_raw` unwrapping loop.
- Replaced the ad-hoc `typeTag` checks with `isString`/`isObject`/`isArray` from `@vue/shared` and simplified the iterable branch with `Array.from`.

Validation: `renderList.spec.ts` (8/8, including the new shallowReactive case), full `runtime-core` suite (898 passed), full `reactivity` suite (393 passed), and no renderList-related typecheck errors.
